sloka: ते वयम् मार्ग विभ्रष्टम् स्वधर्मे परमे स्थिताः ।भरत आज्ञाम् पुरस्कृत्य निगृह्णीमो यथा विधि ॥४-१८-११॥
transliteration: te vayam mārga vibhraṣṭam svadharme parame sthitāḥ ।bharata ājñām puraskṛtya nigṛhṇīmo yathā vidhi ॥4-18-11॥

translations.english: 'By the command of Bharata ,all of us are devoted to our duty of upholding dharma and virtue and duly punish those who deviate from the path of dharma.
